title: John Lennon gives multiple interviews | 1975
content:
John Lennon gave a number of interviews on 21 February 1975.

In order to promote the Rock ‘N’ Roll album, he took part in a conference call with a number of US radio stations. He discussed Beatles studio outtakes, his plans for a future album, and his intentions to visit Paul McCartney in New Orleans.

Afterwards Lennon was interviewed by Chris Charlesworth of the Melody Maker.
